selection_rationale: Cand-1 directly targets the generate–validate–repair pattern identified as a recurring effective design (evidence) and tests safety under distribution shift and adversarial prompts; it is feasible in an emulation-grounded testbed and highly relevant to the CNSM Agentic AI Researcher track while being falsifiable and experimentally clear.
unresolved_uncertainties: Verifier semantic-coverage: deterministic verifier may produce false-safe signals if it does not cover key semantic fault classes (scope and measurable coverage unknown).
External validity: emulation fidelity and synthetic vendor images may not predict production multi-vendor behavior under latency/partial-observability constraints.
Adversary realism: standardizing adversarial-prompt strength and adaptive adversary budgets that are realistic but ethically contained remains unresolved.
Multi-model generality: effect stability across different LLM families/versions under matched prompts is uncertain.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Publish exact deterministic verifier rule set, measurable coverage targets, and include an ablation over verifier-check classes.
Describe emulation fidelity and limitations; include at least one held-out realistic vendor/topology sample and report differences.
Pre-register a blinded adversarial-attack generation procedure with fixed attacker LLM seed and held-out attacks for final evaluation.
Add a second LLM or a sensitivity analysis across model variants; log exact model identifiers, prompts, sampling settings, and seeds.
